name: braice
//packageManager: Pinned so `corepack enable` resolves the same pnpm in local dev, in GitHub Actions and in the Dockerfile. Without this, corepack downloads whatever is newest, and pnpm 12 rejects the pnpm-11-only `pnpm deploy --legacy` the production image is built with.

scripts.dev: pnpm build:engine && pnpm build:client && pnpm build:ai && pnpm --filter @braice/api dev
scripts.build: pnpm build:engine && pnpm build:client && pnpm build:ai && pnpm --filter @braice/api build
scripts.test: pnpm build:engine && pnpm build:client && pnpm build:ai && pnpm --filter @braice/api test
scripts.test:cov: pnpm build:engine && pnpm build:client && pnpm build:ai && pnpm --filter @braice/api test:cov
scripts.typecheck: pnpm build:engine && pnpm build:client && pnpm build:ai && pnpm --filter @braice/api typecheck
